regions.region: upper and middle page: title, graphical abstract, and abstract text
regions.finding: The graphical abstract is a generic three-component reaction family with shared standard conditions, not an individual batch; it was classified as a general_scheme record.
Background claims and cited prior syntheses are literature context and were not imported as experiments of this paper.

unresolved: The graphical abstract uses generic R groups and does not define a single fully specified product structure.

regions.region: left-column opening Results and Discussion prose
regions.finding: The opening 1a/benzylamine/iodobenzene experiment is the same batch as Table 1 entry 1 on page 3 and was merged into that record; 4a was reported in 35% yield exclusively. The prose reverses the 2a/3a labels relative to the Table 1 drawing, so the discrepancy is retained.
Possible carbopalladation and allylic-substitution pathways leading to products A-F are mechanistic/pathway alternatives, not six reported experiments; one mechanism record was created.
ORTEP drawings and crystal data confirm structures/configurations of 4a and 4u; this is characterization evidence linked to corresponding reaction records, not a new synthesis batch.
Cited prior palladium/iridium chemistry and deposited crystallographic records were not treated as experiments newly performed in this paper.

unresolved: The page-2 prose calls phenyl iodide 2a and benzylamine 3a, while the page-3 Table 1 drawing labels benzylamine 2a and PhI 3a; no silent reconciliation was made.
Crystallographic confirmation does not independently establish every machine-generated structure candidate.

regions.region: left-center Table 1, reaction drawing, all 16 rows, and footnotes a-j
regions.finding: All 16 optimization rows were extracted independently, including reflux overrides, ligand identities/loadings, silver-salt amounts, not-detected yields, recovered 1a, the 45% NMR/43% isolated dual result, and the optimized-row stereoisomer observation.

regions.region: upper-right Table 2 reaction drawing, six rows, and footnotes
regions.finding: All six amine-scope rows were extracted independently with the common 10 h standard conditions; the 2.0-equivalent amine overrides for entries 3 and 5 and isolated-yield basis were structured.

regions.region: upper-left and lower-right discussion surrounding Tables 1-3
regions.finding: Optimization interpretation, scope narrative, and the one-stereoisomer statement were merged with their table records rather than duplicated. The Table 3 scope discussion on this page corroborates the 15 rows printed on page 4.

unresolved: The main-text tables do not provide atmosphere, workup, purification, exact masses, or solvent volumes; SI was not provided.
Complex product stereochemical structures remain machine-unverified.

regions.region: upper-left Table 3 reaction drawing, all 15 rows, and footnotes a-d
regions.finding: All 15 substrate/amine/aryl-iodide scope rows were extracted independently with row-specific times and isolated yields; the 2.0-equivalent amine override in entry 11 and Z = C(CO2Me)2 definition were structured.

The 1 g-scale preparation of 4d (10 h, 62%) was treated as a distinct reported batch rather than merged with Table 2 entry 4, which has the same product and yield but a different stated scale context.

regions.region: middle-right Scheme 3 and adjacent selectivity discussion
regions.finding: The anti-7 to 8 to anti-9 pathway is proposed mechanistic rationale and was classified as one mechanism record, not as separate isolated intermediates or experiments.

regions.region: lower-right acknowledgment and Supporting Information notice
regions.finding: The acknowledgment says preparations of 4b, 4i, 4n, and 4t were reproduced; these statements were linked as notes to the corresponding scope rows, not counted as fully specified new batches. SI availability is mentioned, but no SI file was supplied or associated.

unresolved: The reproduced-preparation statement provides no separate quantities, conditions, or yields and therefore was not expanded into four new batch records.
The 62% scale-up yield basis is not explicitly stated in the supplied main text.
Supporting Information was mentioned but not provided or explicitly associated.
